{{Quote|''Technical Lt. Makkor von Urron'' was a double TIE ace by age 18, racking up 11 kills against insurgent Y-wings around Oovri II before a lucky shot took out his knee and put him out of action.|"Aces of the Empire"|<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 8: Tales of the Clone Wars}}</ref>}}
'''Oovri II''' was a celestial body<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located in the [[Oovri system/Legends|Oovri system]], a part of the [[Tungra sector/Legends|Tungra sector]]<ref name="EAOC Oovri" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="WesternReaches" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC Oovri" /> At some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Imperial [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighter]] [[TIE pilot|pilot]] [[Makkor von Urron]] participated in a [[Battle of Oovri II|skirmish]] over Oovri II against a group of insurgents' [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighters]]. During the engagement, von Urron shot down eleven of the enemy [[Starfighter/Legends|craft]] before himself suffering an injury. The [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] exploit at the skirmish was later mentioned as part of a short profile included in<ref name="Author's Cut" /> a [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]<ref name="Date">Per {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-10-the-rise-of-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 10: The Rise of the Empire}}, the edition of "[[Aces of the Empire]]" mentioning the [[Battle of Oovri II|engagement]] at Oovri II is set three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Second Battle of Ord Biniir]], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> edition of the Imperial [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] medium "[[Aces of the Empire]]."<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oovri II was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the celestial body was cut before the book's release. The information regarding Oovri II was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Oovri [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Oovri II, in grid square K-18.<ref name="EAOC Oovri" />
